description: Local calendar date (Asia/Manila).
derivation: Date of the hourly timestamps aggregated.

description: Unique city key (PSGC city name without 'City of'/'City'; 'Name (Province)' where the name is shared).

description: Latitude requested from the API (population-weighted city center).
derivation: Population-weighted mean of barangay centroids.

description: Longitude requested from the API (population-weighted city center).

description: Elevation returned by Open-Meteo for the requested coordinates (90 m DEM used for its statistical downscaling).
derivation: Response field `elevation`.

description: Calendar month of Date.
derivation: Date.month

description: Day of year of Date.
derivation: Date.dayofyear

description: Minimum hourly 2 m air temperature.
derivation: min of hourly temperature_2m

description: Total rain over the day.

description: Number of hours with rain >= 0.1 mm.

description: Daily total shortwave (global horizontal) radiation. Divide by 277.78 for MJ/m².

description: Maximum of the 24 hourly NWS heat-index values of Date.

description: Heat level of HeatIndex_Max_Today.

description: HeatIndex_Max_Today of the next calendar day in the same city.
